env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# bolero clean -testcache
# should work (see golang.org/issue/29757).
cd x
bolero test x_test.go
bolero clean -testcache
bolero test x_test.go
! stdout 'cached'
! bolero clean -testcache ../x
stderr 'bolero: clean -testcache cannot be used with package arguments'

# golang.org/issue/29100: 'bolero clean -testcache' should succeed
# if the cache directory doesn't exist at all.
# It should not write a testexpire.txt file, since there are no
# test results that need to be invalidated in the first place.
env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/nonexistent
bolero clean -testcache
! exists $WORK/nonexistent

-- x/x_test.go --
package x_test
import (
    "testing"
)
func TestMain(t *testing.T) {
}
